title: Hack On Hills 6.0
organizer: AppTeam — where innovation meets the serenity of the hills
description:
HackOnHills is the annual flagship hackathon of NIT Hamirpur, organized by AppTeam — where innovation meets the serenity of the hills. As one of North India's most anticipated tech events, HackOnHills invites passionate minds to code, collaborate, and create solutions that shape the future. With problem statements spanning across Web Development, AI/ML, Blockchain, IoT, Cybersecurity, and more, the hackathon provides a dynamic platform for developers to tackle real-world challenges. Participants get access to expert mentorship, tech resources, and the chance to transform ideas into impactful projects — all while competing against the brightest innovators. Whether you're a seasoned coder or just starting your journey, HackOnHills is where ideas ignite and technology thrives.
Join us amidst the hills to build, innovate, and leave your mark on the future!

description:
HackBlitz is a high-energy, fast-paced hackathon where innovation meets speed. We bring together the brightest minds to collaborate, create, and disrupt the tech world. Participants will face real-world challenges, pushing the limits of their coding and problem-solving skills. Over the course of the event, teams will build groundbreaking solutions, compete for exciting prizes, and have the chance to showcase their talents. Whether you're a seasoned coder or a passionate beginner, HackBlitz is your opportunity to make an impact and shape the future of technology.
We have the following Technical Tracks :
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning , Web and Mobile Development , Blockchain and Decentralized Applications , Health Tech and FinTech

title: BitBox 5.0
description:
GDG JIIT is pleased to announce that we are hosting our annual tech event called “BIT BOX 5.0” in the month of April for students who are interested, all over India.
• It majorly consists of Hackathons along with exciting Tech talks and mini-events.

description:
NMIT Hacks 2025 is a national-level, 48-hour in-person hackathon hosted by the CSE department of NITTE Meenakshi Institute of Technology. This event provides a platform for tech enthusiasts to showcase their creativity and innovation by solving real-world problems. With five exciting tracks - AI/ML, Blockchain, IoT, Game Development, and Open Innovation.
NMIT Hacks 2025 offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with like-minded individuals, learn new skills, and build groundbreaking solutions.
Are you ready to take on the challenge? Register now to be a part of this epic event!

title: MAKEATHON 7
description:
Microsoft Learn Student Chapter is a thriving tech
society at Thapar Institute of Engineering and
Technology. Uniting passionate tech enthusiasts,
we're dedicated to innovation and turning bold ideas
into reality. Our community, always hustling, offers
mutual support and collaborative spirit. Our mission
is to nurture a dynamic, adaptable community of
forward-thinking tech enthusiasts and with that we
present MAKEATHON, our flagship event, a
prestigious 24 hour hackathon.
It marks the inaugural MLH-sponsored gathering at
Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology. In
its ongoing legacy of six successful years,
MAKEATHON returns, dedicated to uniting India's
most skilled and inventive developers. Our event,
ranging from pre- event workshops to intensive boot
camps, nurtures a vibrant atmosphere for learning
and creativity. Our goal is to inspire young minds to
think innovatively and offer them a platform to
address real-world problems with their solutions.

description:
On June 20-22, we host ZK Hack Berlin, our fifth IRL zk-hackathon.
At ZK Hack Berlin, we will be hacking on zk-tools, using zk-DSLs, and building new products that showcase what zk can do. Hackers and builders will get to meet the teams working on zk, learn new skills, find collaborators and friends as well as imagine new ways to use zk in real world applications.
